title: CLAUDE.md
text: zucrypt one package zu* family (siblings checked alongside : zuxlsx, zuxml, zukomp, zuhttp, …). boundary strict main thing preserve: zucrypt owns cryptographic primitives — hashes, HMAC, AES-CBC/ECB, constant-time compare, secure cleanup. must never acquire XML, ZIP, Office, socket TLS dependencies. Family conventions binding (design §3): C ABI prefix zuc_/ZUC_ (never zu_, zukomp’s public namespace compile beside zukomp.h zuxlsx); R exports crypt_*; entry points zucrypt_*; internal zuc_int_*; test-zucrypt_test_*; condition classes zucrypt_*. zukomp’s CLAUDE.md reference. Office/Excel decryption orchestration lives zuxlsx, . Office adapter owns iteration counts, salts, block keys, password verifiers segment IVs; may depend zucrypt zuxml, never reverse. zuhttp owns TLS trust, keeps native OS TLS backend. Mbed TLS separate, optional backend, something zucrypt provides. Three surfaces exposed: small R surface: crypt_info(), crypt_hash(), crypt_hmac(), crypt_equal(), crypt_aes_cbc_encrypt() / crypt_aes_cbc_decrypt(). registered function table (inst/include/zucrypt-r.h, zucrypt_api_v1, resolved lazily via zucrypt_get_api) zuhttp-style consumers: Imports: + LinkingTo: + real importFrom(). static archive inst/lib/libzucrypt.zuxlsx-style consumers (LinkingTo: + configure resolving system.file("lib"), Imports:). contains R-free adapter plus vendored crypto — raw upstream, unlike zukomp/zuxml’s archives — consumers see inst/include/zucrypt.h, must compile standalone C99 R PSA vocabulary. backend vendored, pinned TF-PSA-Crypto crypto subset (TLS, X.509) — currently 1.1.1, LTS branch. Mbed TLS file vendored: 4.x architecture TF-PSA-Crypto whole cryptography library Mbed TLS supplies X.509 TLS. Installation downloads nothing needs Python Perl; release archive ships generated sources. Upstream symbols hidden (PKG_CFLAGS = $(C_VISIBILITY)) independent vendored copies bind , tests/testthat/test-abi.R asserts shared object exports R_init_zucrypt nothing else.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Binary arguments raw vectors . character value never interpreted filename, password byte sequence. Algorithm names exact scalars — partial matching, fallback. AES wrappers add/strip padding authentication; keys must 16/24/32 bytes, IVs exactly 16, data multiple 16. Authentication caller’s responsibility. SHA-1 AES-ECB exist purely Office compatibility never defaults new formats. encrypt_file(password = ), PBKDF2/HKDF/AEAD/RNG initial scope — needs concrete consumer first. future randomness uses platform entropy seeded backend RNG, never R’s RNG. Errors R conditions c(<specific>, "zucrypt_error", "error", "condition") built R zuc_status, mapped enumerator name; never attach keys, passwords plaintext. C returns status codes, never Rf_error() outermost .Call; heap state must survive longjmp (Rf_error, R_CheckUserInterrupt) owned finalized external pointer. Vendoring uses family layout — src/vendor/<source>/, tools/patches/, tools/vendor/{manifest.tsv,checksums.sha256,fetch,record,verify}, inst/COPYRIGHTS — src/Makevars portable make explicit OBJECTS list (CMake, GNU make). Two local departures, .agents/stage-1-spike.md: trim two-column keep list (tools/vendor/keep/<source>.txt) rather keep_files() case arm, tree flattened inc/ lib/ upstream’s paths exceed 100-byte tarball limit. Never edit src/vendor/ place: change keep list add patch, re-run tools/vendor/fetch tools/vendor/record, tools/vendor/verify committing. API resolution calls main-thread 0.1. Testing gate: published known-answer vectors per algorithm, one-shot vs incremental equivalence, independent-implementation compatibility — self round trip explicitly sufficient. Tests must run offline synthetic fixtures.
